flags: KOVO (volleyball) and KBL/WKBL (basketball) November home dates could not be fetched statically — their sites are JavaScript-rendered (KOVO schedule URL returns HTTP 500; KBL returns 'page not found' without JS). Re-check kovo.co.kr / kbl.or.kr / wkbl.or.kr in October 2026 before booking.

Busan Museum of Art (BMA): main building closed Dec 18, 2023 – Sep 16, 2026 for renovation; reopening announced for Sep 17, 2026 (CEN News, Aug 26, 2026) with 4 opening exhibitions (Future Museology, '1945-1953', 'All the Museums of Yesterday'). Space Lee Ufan open Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00. It was free while the main building was closed — admission rules may change with the reopening; check art.busan.go.kr before the trip.
Busan MoCA (Eulsukdo): official site returned HTTP 500 on Aug 30, 2026; possible de-installation closure after Biennale (ended Nov 1). Check the notice board before the long ride out.

Lotte World Adventure Busan: November hours are date-specific — today's official page shows 10:00–21:00; check the park-schedule calendar (adventurebusan.lotteworld.com) the day before. Also in the same Osiria cluster: Ahopsan Forest and Busan National Science Museum (both closed Mondays — fine for Sun Nov 15).
Gwangalli M Drone Light Show is weather-dependent (cancelled for wind/rain/poor visibility). Nov 7 (fireworks night) has special programming; Nov 14 is a normal Saturday show.
'Turn Toward Busan' is an annual Nov 11 11:00 ceremony at UNMCK — the cemetery itself is verified open 365 days; confirm the ceremony timing via Visit Busan closer to the date.
Culture Day cinema discount (₩10,000/₩8,000) applies to screenings STARTING 17:00–21:00 on the 2nd and last Wednesday — check the actual screening time before booking.
Blueline Sky Capsule sells out — book online ahead (free cancellation 3 days out; 50% charge on the day).
Jagalchi Market closed days (1st & 3rd Tuesdays) fall on Nov 3 & Nov 17 in 2026 — both outside the stay; the market is open for the entire visit.

Several restaurants were removed from the source food guide because two official pages disagreed on hours (e.g., Shinbalwon, Nagahama Mangetsu, Haeundae Ilpum Hanwoo, Mori, LAB XXIV). If you go anyway, check hours on Naver Map the morning of.
Prices/hours above were verified Aug 17–30, 2026 from official pages; re-confirm closer to travel as they can change.
Weather risk in November: Igidae/Oryukdo, drone show, Yeongdo Bridge lift and the Songdo cable car can close/cancel in wind or rain.

F1963 Othoniel exhibition is closed every Monday and last entry is 17:30 — it is a late-afternoon stop, not an evening one; the free garden installation (Gold Lotus) can be seen outside closing hours.

Check-out time — RESOLVED (Aug 31, 2026): the official L7 site (prerendered mirror) lists check-in 15:00 / check-out 11:00 for all dates; the earlier 12:00 figure came from a stale page. This plan keeps before-11:00 checkout.

itineraries.title: Remembrance Day — UNMCK & Culture Day at Centum
itineraries.transit: Two metro rides on one line: Line 2 Haeundae→Daeyeon (~10 stops, ~25 min) in the morning, then Daeyeon→Centum City (7 stops back east, ~15 min) in the afternoon. Everything at each stop is on foot.

steps.detail: ~10 stops (~25 min), one line. UNMCK is an 18-min walk from Daeyeon Exit 3 (official Visit Busan), so factor that in.
Open 365 days; Oct–Apr 09:00–17:00, free. Wall of Remembrance (40,896 names). Keep quiet; no food/pets (etiquette rules on the official page).
Annual ceremony for UN Korean War dead, observed at 11:00 KST worldwide. Free.
Municipal history museum next to the cemetery; 09:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00); free; closed Mondays and Jan 1 — Wed Nov 11 is open.
Daeyeon Milmyeon (11:00–17:00, last order 16:50; closed Tue — open Wed) or Ssangdungi Dwaejigukbap (09:00–22:00).
Same Line 2, Daeyeon → Centum City: 7 stops east (~15 min). Continue on foot within the Centum cluster.

steps.detail: Culture Day (2nd & last Wed): 2D ₩10,000 adult / ₩8,000 youth for screenings STARTING 17:00–21:00. Check the Dureraum screening calendar for Nov 11.
Line 2 Centum City → Haeundae: 3 stops (~8 min).

itineraries.title: Nampo Old Town — Jagalchi, Gukje, Busan Tower
itineraries.transit: One commuter ride from Haeundae; then walk the Nampo cluster

steps.detail: Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon (16 stops) + Line 1 Seomyeon→Nampo (8 stops) ≈ 45 min incl. transfer. Alternatively a taxi (~35–40 min).
1969 Buwondong Kalguksu (11:00–19:30, daily — often sells out ~18:00) or Nampo Samgyetang (Mon–Fri 11:00–20:50, break 15:30–16:30).
Korea's largest seafood market; 05:00–22:00; closed 1st & 3rd Tuesdays (Nov 3 & 17 — outside this window). Live-fish floor + rooftop deck.
Gukje Market: most stalls 09:00–20:00, closed 1st & 3rd Sundays (Nov 15 is the 3rd — not today, Thu Nov 12). Bosu-dong Book Alley is one block away.
Escalator up from Gwangbok-ro; tower 10:00–22:00 (last ticket 21:30), ₩12,000 adult / ₩9,000 child & senior. Sunset 17:19 on Nov 12 — time your climb and catch both.
Hwaguk Banjeom (Korean-Chinese, 43 yrs; 11:30–15:30/17:00–21:30; closed 1st & 3rd Mon — open Thu) or Bugwang Dwaejigukbap (09:30–19:30; closed Sun — open Thu).
Night market 19:30–23:30 (KTO) / until 24:00 (Visit Busan), open daily year-round, next to Gukje Market. Magic show + guitar performances twice a day (KTO).

highlights: Busan Tower & Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market
meals: 1969 Buwondong Kalguksu or Nampo Samgyetang
Hwaguk Banjeom or Bugwang Dwaejigukbap

itineraries.title: Seomyeon Food & Gugak Concert Night
itineraries.difficulty: Busy — anchored on a confirmed concert
itineraries.transit: One metro ride in the morning (Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon, 16 stops, ~28 min); the day is then all walking (Seomyeon–Jeonpo–Busan Citizens Park–Gugak Center).

steps.detail: 16 stops (~28 min), one line, no transfer.
Gijang Sonkalguksu (09:00–21:00, hand-cut noodles + gimbap) or Hanttukbaegi (24h, suyuk) or Seo-myeon Gaegeum Milmyeon (winter 09:30–21:00).
Coffee district in former machine shops; Casa De Lux (media-art café, 11:10–20:00) or BLACKUP COFFEE (10:00–22:00).
Central park on the former Camp Hialeah site. Free.

steps.what: National Gugak Center — Gugak Experience Hall
steps.detail: Hands-on traditional-music exhibits; Mon–Sat 09:00–21:00 (closed Sun). The experience hall closes at 21:00, so it works before the 19:30 concert next door.

steps.what: CONCERT: Gugak: Korea in Sound — Yeji-dang, ₩10,000
steps.detail: CONFIRMED Fri Nov 13, 19:30, small theater (276 seats). All seats ₩10,000; tickets on sale from Oct 13, 2026, 14:00. Series runs to Nov 14 — this is the final weekend. ☎ 051-811-0114.
TETE O NE (dining bar, 15:00–24:00; closed Mon/Tue — open Fri) or 24h Hanttukbaegi.

highlights: LIVE CONCERT: Gugak Korea in Sound (19:30, Yeji-dang)
meals: Gijang Sonkalguksu or Hanttukbaegi (24h)
TETE O NE (dining bar) or Cor Pasta Bar (Bib Gourmand)

itineraries.title: Signature Day — Yeongdo Bridge Lift & Gwangalli Drone Show
itineraries.transit: Two metro trips: morning Haeundae→Nampo (Line 2 → Line 1 via Seomyeon, 24 stops, ~45–50 min); late afternoon Nampo→Gwangalli (Line 1 → Line 2 via Seomyeon, 18 stops, ~35–40 min). Taxi Nampo→Gwangalli is ~15 min if preferred — the price of stacking both headline events.

steps.detail: Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon (16 stops) + Line 1 Seomyeon→Nampo (8 stops) ≈ 45–50 min incl. transfer.
Original fish-cake shop since 1953; 09:00–19:00 daily. Walk across the bridge to Yeongdo.
White cliffside village + Jeoryeong coastal boardwalk. Free.
Nampo Samgyetang (11:00–20:50).
CONFIRMED Saturdays only, 14:00, 15 minutes. Watch from Yurari Square (Nampo end). Korea's only bascule bridge. Free. Cancelled in heavy wind/rain.
Open (Jagalchi closed days are Nov 3/17 — not today).
10:00–22:00, last ticket 21:30, ₩12,000. Sunset 17:18 on Nov 14. Only if the morning didn't wipe you out — the markets + bridge already fill the day.
Line 1 Nampo → Seomyeon (8 stops) + Line 2 Seomyeon → Gwangan (10 stops) ≈ 35–40 min; Gwangan Station is roughly a 10-min walk to the beach.
Gwangangukbap (24h) or Chilseong Hoetjip (12:00–22:00, sea-view raw fish) or 100.1.pyeongnaeng (11:30–15:30 / 17:00–19:00 — kitchen closes 19:00, go early).
CONFIRMED every Sat; winter schedule 19:00 & 21:00; ~12 min; 1,100+ drones over Gwangan Bridge; free; weather-dependent.
Second show at 21:00 if you want the full set; then Line 2 back to Haeundae (~12 min).

meals: Nampo Samgyetang or Samjin Eomuk
Millak Raw Fish Market or Gwangangukbap (24h)

itineraries.title: Gijang Coast — Temple, Park & Sea
itineraries.transit: Taxi ~40 min each way to the Gijang coast (or bus) — a single-destination day; everything there is local. Alternative return: Gwangan is 6 stops from Haeundae on Line 2 for a Gwangalli evening.

steps.detail: Seaside temple on the Gijang coast; free; open from 04:30–19:20 (entry closes ~18:50); go early to beat crowds.

steps.what: Lotte World Adventure Busan (or Ahopsan Forest / Sciport)
steps.detail: ⚠️ November hours are date-specific — check the park-schedule calendar first. Current hours 10:00–21:00. Alternatives: Ahopsan bamboo forest (closed Mon — open Sun) or Busan National Science Museum (closed Mon — open Sun).

Mujinjang Hoetjip (raw conger eel, Gijang-eup; 11:00–21:00, open all year) or Janganjip (duck hanok house, Jangan-eup; 11:00–20:30, closed Tue — open Sun; note it is an ~1-hr drive from Haeundae, further than the coast cluster).

steps.what: Café stop — PREST or Sea & Tree
steps.detail: PREST hanok café (Tue–Sun 12:00–21:00, closed Mon) or Sea & Tree ocean-view café (Wed–Sun 11:00–22:00).

steps.what: Return to Haeundae; Gwangalli sunset alternative
steps.detail: If energy remains: Line 2 six stops (roughly 12 min) back east to Gwangan for a bridge-lights dinner (Gwangangukbap 24h). Sunset on Nov 15 is 17:17 — the Gwangalli lights take over after that.

meals: Janganjip (장안집)
PREST Hanok Café or Sea & Tree ocean-view café

itineraries.title: Rest & Spa Day (swap for any busy day)
itineraries.transit: Line 2 Haeundae→Centum City is only 3 stops (~8 min) — or a ~25-min beach-side walk; otherwise hotel-adjacent. (F1963 option: Line 2 to Namcheon + bus/taxi.)

steps.detail: Free coastal walk.

steps.what: Shinsegae Centum City food hall lunch
steps.detail: 3 stops on Line 2 from Haeundae (Dongbaek, BEXCO, Centum City) or a ~25-min walk along the beach road.

08:00–23:00 (last entry 22:00) per the store notice — the detail panel on the same official page prints 09:00–22:00, so call 1668-2850; a 13:30 start works either way. ₩26,000 adult / ₩21,000 student (born 2008–2019). ⚠️ Ticket = 4 HOURS (+₩5,000/hr after; spend ₩10,000+ inside → 6 hours). Elementary age and up. Closed one weekday a month (department-store holiday). 1668-2850.

steps.what: Optional: F1963 — Othoniel “In the Labyrinth of Love” (last entry 17:30)
steps.detail: Jean-Michel Othoniel, ~100 works, first Korean solo show of this scale. 28 Aug–31 Dec 2026; 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:30; closed Mondays. ₩10,000 adult / ₩8,000 youth / ₩6,000 child. Official directions: Line 3 Mangmi (Exit 4) + Suyeong-gu village bus 2 to 'Sanjeong Apartment', or a ~10-min taxi from Centum City — sits between Centum and Millak, so it pairs with the dinner stop. ⚠️ Do not use this step on a Monday (exhibition closed weekly Mondays).
ALOI THAI (Millak; closed Tue — pick a non-Tue day) or Gwangangukbap (24h). (F1963 is in Suyeong-gu between Centum City and Millak — a short taxi hop from the dinner area.)

highlights: Shinsegae Centum Spa Land (4-hour thermal bathhouse)
F1963 Othoniel: In the Labyrinth of Love art show
meals: Shinsegae Centum food hall
ALOI THAI (Millak) or Gwangangukbap (24h)

itineraries.title: Departure Morning — Haeundae Send-off

steps.detail: Sunrise over the east coast; free.

Hotel option: Floating on the 2nd floor serves breakfast buffet 07:00–10:00 daily (L7 official site; the 2024-04 B&B package page is dead — book by phone ☎ +82-51-771-1000). Otherwise a beachfront café — note most proper breakfast options (e.g. Daeyeon Milmyeon) open at 10:00, too late for this slot.

Luggage first — check-out is before 11:00 and the lobby is small. A final 20-min walk along Haeundae Beach or up Dongbaekseom is free and easy; Hotel L7 offers luggage storage after check-out if your flight/coach is later.

steps.what: SEA LIFE quick visit (optional, if time)
steps.detail: SEA LIFE is under Haeundae Beach, 1 min from the hotel: Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, last entry 18:00. A 10:00–10:45 hop is realistic only if you're fully packed first.
Before 11:00 AM.

meals: L7 Floating 2F Breakfast Buffet or beachfront café

itineraries.title: Dongnae Heritage & Hot Springs — Temple Foliage
itineraries.transit: One metro ride: Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon (16 stops, ~28 min) + Line 1 Seomyeon→Beomeosa (14 stops, ~25–28 min) ≈ 55–60 min one-way. Then bus/taxi ~10 min to the temple. Afternoon: Line 1 Beomeosa→Oncheonjang (6 stops, ~12 min). Everything at each stop is walkable.

steps.detail: Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon (16 stops) + Line 1 Seomyeon→Beomeosa (14 stops, 13.8 km) ≈ 55–60 min total. Then bus or taxi ~10 min to temple entrance.
Arrive ~10:00. One of Korea's great mountain temples; grounds open daily; free. Mid-November = peak foliage on Geumjeongsan. Main hall, Daeungjeon, and the three-story stone pagoda are highlights.
Dongnae Milmyeon (daily 10:00–24:00) or Dongnae Halmae Pajeon (11:30–15:00/17:00–21:30; closed Mon — open Tue) or Wonjo Kkorigomjip (08:30–21:30; closed Mon — open Tue).
Historic fortress site and shrine to Admiral Yi Sun-sin; free; daytime access. Walk from Oncheonjang area.
Traditional jjimjilbang hot-spring bathhouse; Hotel Nongshim is the landmark operator. Ticketed; operator-controlled hours.

Line 1 Oncheonjang→Seomyeon (8 stops) + Line 2 Seomyeon→Haeundae (16 stops) ≈ 50–55 min. Dinner ~19:30 at Haeundae: Haeundae Gaya Milmyeon (10:00–20:50, no closing day) or Matchandeul Wangsogeumgui (16:00–01:00, hanwoo BBQ).

highlights: Heosimcheong Hot Springs at Hotel Nongshim
meals: Dongnae Milmyeon or Dongnae Halmae Pajeon
Matchandeul Wangsogeumgui or Haeundae Gaya Milmyeon

itineraries.title: Gamcheon Culture Village & West Busan Art Day
itineraries.transit: One metro ride to Nampo cluster (Line 2→Line 1 via Seomyeon, ~45 min), then taxi/bus ~10 min to Gamcheon. Afternoon: walk/bus back to Nampo for Songdo Cable Car. All west-Busan activities cluster together.

steps.detail: Line 2 Haeundae→Seomyeon (16 stops) + Line 1 Seomyeon→Nampo (8 stops) ≈ 45 min.
The 'Machu Picchu of Busan'; colorful hillside houses, murals, and art installations. Open daily; stamp-map from info center. Taxi from Nampo ~10 min or city bus. Residential area — keep noise down.
Halmaejip Hoeguksu (10:30–19:00; closed 2nd & 4th Tue — open Thu) or Halmae Gaya Milmyeon (10:30–21:30, daily).
Air Cruise ₩19,000 adult RT (Crystal cabin ₩24,000); operator-controlled hours; weather can stop the cable car. From Nampo: taxi ~15 min or bus. The skywalk and beach are free.
Free; closed Mondays — open Thu. Walk from Jagalchi/Nampo area. Covers Busan's port history and Korean War era.
10:00–22:00, last ticket 21:30, ₩12,000. Sunset 17:19 on Nov 12. Yongdusan Park escalator from Gwangbok-ro.
Hwaguk Banjeom (Korean-Chinese, 11:30–15:30/17:00–21:30; closed 1st & 3rd Mon — open Thu) or Seoul Samgyetang (10:00–22:30). Then Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market (19:30–23:30, daily).
Line 1 Nampo→Seomyeon + Line 2 Seomyeon→Haeundae ≈ 45 min.

highlights: Songdo Marine Cable Car & Skywalk over the ocean
Busan Modern History Museum & Busan Tower sunset
meals: Halmaejip Hoeguksu or Halmae Gaya Milmyeon
Hwaguk Banjeom & Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market

itineraries.title: Igidae Coastal Walk & Gwangalli Evening
itineraries.transit: Line 2 Haeundae→Kyungsung Univ·Pukyong Univ (9 stops, ~20 min) + local bus to the Igidae entrance (~10 min). Afternoon: Line 2 Kyungsung Univ·Pukyong Univ→Gwangan (3 stops, ~7 min). All coastal walking once at Igidae.

steps.detail: Line 2 Haeundae→Kyungsung Univ·Pukyong Univ (9 stops, ~20 min) + local bus to the trail entrance (~10 min). Igidae is open daily including Mondays; winter hours 09:00–18:00.
Stunning cliff-top trail with views of Oryukdo (five/six islands); ~3.6 km one-way; free. Weather closures possible (call 051-607-6395).
Glass-bottom skywalk at the end of the Igidae trail; free; winter hours 09:00–18:00. Views of the Oryukdo islands.
Oryukdogawon (11:30–21:30; closed Lunar New Year/Chuseok) or bus to Gwangalli for Gwangalli Eonyang Bulgogi Busanjip (11:00–21:30, daily).
Free beach with Gwangan Bridge views; cafes along the shore. 100.1.pyeongnaeng (11:30–15:30/17:00–19:00) for cold noodles if you haven't eaten.
Taxi ~10 min from Gwangalli to F1963. 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:30; closed Mondays. ₩10,000 adult. Free Gold Lotus garden installation visible outside hours.
Chilseong Hoetjip (12:00–22:00, raw fish with bridge view) or Gwangangukbap (24h) or Donggyeong Bapsang (11:30–15:00/17:30–21:00; closed Mon).
Gwangan Bridge lights up nightly; beautiful evening view. Line 2 Gwangan→Haeundae: 6 stops (~12 min).

highlights: Igidae Coastal Cliff Walk (3.6 km trail)
Oryukdo Skywalk glass platform over the sea
Gwangalli Beach sunset & F1963 Othoniel exhibition
meals: Oryukdogawon or Gwangalli Eonyang Bulgogi Busanjip
Chilseong Hoetjip or Donggyeong Bapsang

trip_presets.name: Food First — Busan Eats Edition
trip_presets.description: Every day anchored by verified Busan tables: Woobong Shabu's 1++ paper-pot shabu, Haeundae Amso Galbijip (since 1964), Nampo's 1969 Buwondong kalguksu and Hwaguk Banjeom's Korean-Chinese dishes, Dongnae pajeon with temple foliage, the Seomyeon food street, Gwangalli raw fish under the drone show — plus Kkangtong night-market street food.
